title: Booking.com Hotel Scraper Input
description: Scrape Booking.com by destination or a saved search URL. Use fast mode for search-card data or detailed mode for rooms, availability, facilities, images, policies, address, coordinates, and surroundings.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: List of destinations to search, e.g. London, United Kingdom. Start with one destination for a low-cost test.

searchUrls.title: Booking.com Search URLs
searchUrls.description: Optional Booking.com search-results URLs. Paste URLs after applying filters on Booking.com; the Actor preserves those filters while paginating. When supplied, URL mode takes priority over destinations.

checkIn.title: Check-in Date
checkIn.description: Optional future check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank to use 30 days after the run date.

checkOut.title: Check-out Date
checkOut.description: Optional future check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank to use one night after check-in.

rooms.title: Number of Rooms
rooms.description: Number of rooms to search for.

childrenAges.title: Children Ages
childrenAges.description: Age of each child, from 0 to 17. Repeated ages are allowed. Example: [5, 9].

propertyTypes.title: Property Type Filters
propertyTypes.description: Optional property type filters. Allowed values: Hotels, Apartments, Hostels, Villas, Resorts, B&Bs, Guest houses. Leave empty for all accommodation types.

minReviewScore.title: Minimum Review Score
minReviewScore.description: Only include properties with a guest review score at or above this threshold. Leave 0 for the broadest first test.

minPrice.title: Minimum Stay Price
minPrice.description: Optional minimum total price in the selected currency.

maxPrice.title: Maximum Stay Price
maxPrice.description: Optional maximum total price in the selected currency.

sortBy.title: Sort Results By
sortBy.description: Booking.com result ordering for destination searches. URL mode keeps the ordering from the pasted URL.

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of properties per destination or search URL. The Actor follows Booking.com's next-page links and stops at this limit.

language.title: Booking.com Language
language.description: Language used for Booking.com labels and policies. URL mode keeps the language in the pasted URL when present.

scrapeDetails.title: Detailed Property & Room Data
scrapeDetails.description: Visit each property page to add room options, prices, occupancy, meal plans, cancellation policies, availability, facilities, photos, address, coordinates, check-in/out times, description, and surroundings. Slower than fast mode and billed at $5 per 1,000 detailed hotel records. Uses datacenter proxy to keep the price predictable.

maxImages.title: Maximum Images Per Property
maxImages.description: Maximum property images returned in detailed mode.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for scraping. Apify Proxy or a suitable custom proxy is required for cloud runs because Booking.com challenges direct Apify cloud traffic. Leave groups empty for the default datacenter pool. Fast mode can retry on residential when needed; detailed mode does not use Apify Residential because its transfer cost would require an uncompetitive result price. Custom proxy URLs remain supported.
